question: The 'Institute of Indian Languages ​​(CIIL)' is located in which of these cities?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Mysore.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Institute of Indian Languages ​​(CIIL)**

 
 
• **​**__In **Mysuru, Karnataka,** there is a research and teaching facility for Indian languages called the Central Institute of Indian Languages (CIIL).
 
• It is a division of the **Ministry of Human Resource Development's Language Bureau.** The institute's mission is to preserve and catalogue minor, indigenous, and tribal languages.
 
• By instructing **non-native students in 15 Indian languages, it encourages linguistic concord. **
 
• **It was established on July 17, 1969.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__** **The Central Institute of Indian Languages has seven centres:**

 
• Centre for **Classical Languages.**
 
• Centre for **Tribal, Minor, Endangered Languages and Languages Policy.**
 
• Centre for** Lexicography, Folklore, Literature and Translation Studies.**
 
• Centre for** Literacy Studies.**
 
• Centre for** Testing & Evaluation.**
 
• Centre for** Materials Production, Publications and Sales.**
 
• Centre for** Information in Indian Languages.**
